question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

CHERISH
solution:
The correct answer is 'disregard.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Cherish' means **to love somebody or something and look after him or her or it carefully**. (किसी से स्‍नेह करना और सावधानीपूर्वक देखरेख में रखना)

 
 
• Example: *A man promises to **cherish** his wife*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of the given options:-
 
 
• 'Distribute' means **to give things to a number of people**. (वितरण करना, बाँट देना)
 
 
• Example: *The relief agency will **distribute** the food among several countries*.
 
 
 
• 'Disperse' means **to separate and go in different directions; to make somebody or something do this**. (बिखर जाना, विसर्जित हो जाना; बिखरा देना, विसर्जित कर देना)
 
 
• Example: *Police used tear gas to **disperse** the crowd*.
 
 
 
• 'Disturb' means **to interrupt somebody while he or she is doing something or sleeping; to spoil a peaceful situation**. (किसी के कुछ काम करते समय उसमें बाधा पहुँचाना अथवा नींद में व्यवधान डालना; शांति भंग करना)
 
 
• Example: *Please don't **disturb** me while I'm working*.
 
 
 
• 'Disregard' means **to take no notice of somebody or something; to treat something as unimportant**. (किसी की उपेक्षा करना, किसी बात पर ध्यान न देना; किसी बात को महत्वहीन या उपेक्षणीय समझना)
 
 
• Example: *She shows a total **disregard** for other people's feelings*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonyms of the word 'Cherish' are "disregard, **ignore, neglect**".
 
• The synonyms of the word 'Cherish' are "retain, keep, preserve".
